product_metadata.title: Kenmore 10135 Pet Friendly Bagless Progressive Upright Vacuum w/Pet Handi-Mate, HEPA Filter, Telescoping Wand, 4-Height Adjustments, 2 Cleaning Tools-Red/Silver
features: BAGLESS UPRIGHT VACUUM: Remove pet hair, dust and more with this lightweight multifloor, multi-surface designed vacuum for use in your home, den, or kitchen-includes a wide sweeper path
PET HANDIMATE: Air driven turbine spins roller brush to high RPM easily removing dander, stubborn pet hair and other debris
HEPA FILTER SYSTEM: Dual filter system traps 99.7% of debris, trapping dander and dust inside the vacuum reducing allergy-induced pollutants in the room. Primary filter is washable
CYCLONIC CLEANING POWER: 2-motors power Cyclonic technology with centrifugal force to create powerful suction pulling dirt and hair from carpet, cracks and upholstery
EASY EMPTY CANISTER: Liftaway dust/dirt bin is quickly detachable and easy to clean
2 ATTACHMENTS AND ADJUSTABLE WAND: Quick-Draw wand extends to a reach of 10'. Dusting brush and crevice tool store on wand
ENHANCEMENTS: Lightweight at only 18 lbs. Bristles extend to each side of agitator, 25' cord, cleaning width of 14", 6 height adjustments
description: The Kenmore Bagless HEPA Upright Vacuum with Pet Handi-Mate and Extended Bristle design eliminates dirt, pesky pet hair, allergen-inducing dust and dander. This multipurpose all-floors design is perfect on all floors. The Pet HandiMate has an air driven turbine which spins the roller brush to high RPMs, easily removing dander, stubborn pet hair and other debris off furniture, stairs, car and van seats. With the HEPA filter system, 99.97% of debris, dander, dust particles, pollen and bacteria will be trapped and kept inside the vacuum, so exhaust air is clean reducing the number of allergy-induced pollutants in the room, which is ideal for allergy sufferers and pet owners. Washable primary filter restores performance without replacement. This vacuum's 2-motor system and Kenmore's exclusive Power Flow technology ensure you won't lose suction or leave debris behind and the powerful agitation system, with extended agitator bristles deep cleans carpets all the way to the baseboards and easily switches to bare floors with the tap of a foot on the easy access pedal control. Cyclonic Technology centrifugal force creates powerful, consistent suction that pulls dirt and pet hair easily from carpet fibers, deep piles, rugs, cracks, stairs, vehicles and upholstery. The Reach-Out telescoping wand includes attachments, and a flexible hose, that help you get places you normally couldn't reach with an upright. Accessories include: Pet Handi Mate, bare floor brush and combo tool (crevice / dusting brush) to clean hard-to-reach places, and aluminum telescoping wand. All attachments are stored onboard the unit for easy access and storage. This vacuum features an LED light, a dirt sensor and electronic performance indicators, which illuminate when the bag is full, or when the hose or handle is clogged. Make housework less of a hassle, by investing in this HEPA pet-friendly Ultra Plush bagless vacuum from Kenmore.
